answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a real field season on a surveyed knoll: weeks of uncompressible excavation under a licensed director who issues one tamper-evident artifact cipher per trainee. One director mentors one trainee per season, so farms cannot parallelize, and the permit fee in outside money doubles for every further identity on the same funding trail. Each extra fake therefore costs another human's weeks in the dirt, another supervisor slot, and twice the prior fee, driving the attacker's budget toward its nadir while honest agents pay once.
